content.comment_body: Thank you for the information. I've finished mapping everything, but I'm unable to make any changes. I can see the times set in my program, but I may need a way to adjust the time and days. I hope my question is clear. Kind regards, [user_name]

I understand your request. However, without reviewing your [product_name] program and the [product_name] project, I can't provide an answer. Please upload your program and project files as a ZIP archive.
Hello, sorry for the inconvenience. The ZIP file is now attached. Best regards, [user_name]

You seem to be having some confusion with the days. The correct bits for weekdays weren't mapped in your [product_name] project. In the Parameter VM Mapping, you defined VB34 for the weekdays of cam 1 as follows: MO = V34.1, DI = V34.2, MI = V34.3, DO = V34.4, FR = V34.5, SA = V34.6, SO = V34.0. Similar errors are present for cam 2: MO = V35.1, DI = V35.2, MI = V35.3, DO = V35.4, FR = V35.5, SA = V35.6, SO = V35.0. The ON/OFF times are correctly mapped.
Thanks, I see the issue. I've corrected the mapping and can confirm it works now. Thanks again for your assistance. Best regards, [user_name]
I'm glad the system is now functioning properly.

analysis.insight_summary: Users encountered issues when configuring weekly timers in [product_name], particularly with mapping weekdays to the correct memory bits. The incorrect parameter mapping prevented them from changing times and days through the web interface, leading to confusion over control functionality until the error was identified and corrected. The challenge involved properly understanding VM mapping for weekday selection and its impact on editing capabilities.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect to be able to easily adjust timer schedules by changing times and selecting days via the web interface, without running into configuration errors or restrictions.
